notes.title: Aegis Force: The Scorian War || Demo Patch Update #1
notes.content:
[p]Hail, soldiers of Genua! The Scorian War rages on, and we're here with a brand-new patch to help you navigate its battlefields :)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch #1 Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]All new foliage, trees, flowers, and skybox for Ruiner's Pass[/p][/*][*][p]Level bounds collision rework[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Input for closing tutorial screens to cancel button (B or Backspace)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted camera occlusion transparency on certain background props[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support in squashing bugs! Please continue reporting any issues you find to us. 

- [b][i]The Aegis Force Team[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: September 2025 Dev Update
notes.content: [p]Greetings soldiers of Genua! We launched the new and improved demo on 9/2/25, so if you haven't already, go give it a try! Stay tuned as we keep this demo updated with bug fixes, UI updates, and some new content... [/p][h1]Technical Updates[/h1][p]August was CRUNCH time for our dev and art team as we prepped for the new demo launch. We're still working on applying all the new UI updates, portrait art and mechanics to our original prologue so we limited the demo launch to just the new content in Ruiners Pass (Chapter 1). However, we're planning on incorporating the Lendene prologue back into the demo once that work is complete![/p][p][b]What's coming up this month?[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Demo bug fixing - multiple visual glitches and soft locks[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusting UI layout[/p][/*][*][p]Add visual of health bars when selecting an ability during combat[/p][/*][*][p]Polish Dragon's Gale tech move [/p][/*][*][p]Work on sound and VFX updates[/p][/*][/list][h1]Art Corner[/h1][p]One of our in-house artists created a beautiful vista of the capital city of Genua, Vigherad, which we are just in love with! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/fe0cc49ef4081dac8bdf70969b01ff767eb4f177.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And of course, you can get some amazing views playing through the new demo. Here's a sneak peek of the first couple minutes in the demo: [/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/ce8abbc5ca96dbcb89f7c377df555c42613e01cd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/f3eb67ce93aac2d93b9b6ff30a85e6397d1bd1be.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/0b68f5a19abe7302c09e0811fa206b89b38780d2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/c0d575c1a1e266d04418c605106f451328f9d871.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/24b9383434a2e73c808550ad67d835bc0c93264b.png"][/img][/carousel][h1]Social Space[/h1][p]With all the exciting updates with the new demo and trailer, we also got spotlighted by several big creators and news outlets, which was a huge deal to the team. IGN showed off our new trailer and it's currently sitting at 55K views!! If you haven't seen the new trailer yet, go check it out on our Youtube channel. [/p][previewyoutube="nt_jTgNVci8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Also, we're having a lot of fun in our Discord and social media channels sharing new art, creator videos, and gathering all the great ideas from the community. We held a community stream of the new demo last week and will plan on holding more events like this in the future. Join the Discord today to stay in the know ːsteamhappyː [url="https://discord.gg/9CTeRq2Dzn" style="button" buttoncolor="#9937fb"]Join our Discord![/url][/p][p]Now for a more serious update, some of you may have noticed that we recently removed some of our 14 day demo countdown social media posts that showed off some of the early character concept art. We want to be transparent and let you know that we discovered that two of our contract concept artists (not our employees or in-house art team) had plagiarized aspects of their work. The issue only affected some of our early character concepts, and we are actively making changes to ensure the originality of our final product. Deseret Games is a small, independent studio that thrives on creativity, and our team was upset to find that our contractors didn't match the artistic integrity we strive for in all aspects of our game. We don't anticipate having this problem again, but we have also put an art review process in place for everything going forward to ensure we aren't taken advantage of by any unscrupulous actors in the future. When new concept art is available, we'll share it with all of you and update our press kit! [/p][h1]What's Coming[/h1][p]This month, we're tackling the big list of fixes and updates for the demo while also working on new concept art, animations, and character designs. Thank you for going on this incredible journey with us so far, and we hope you're looking forward to what's coming next![/p]

notes.title: August 2025 Developer Update
notes.content: [p]Greetings soldiers of Genua! [/p][h1]Technical Updates[/h1][p]Our team has been heads down, hard at work putting the final touches on the expanded demo planned for release later this month. This demo will include the original Lendene prologue AND the Ruiners Pass section of Chapter 1! Changes made in July include: [/p][list][*][p]New victory screen and team pose[/p][/*][*][p]Sprint is now fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced character damage and health stats[/p][/*][*][p]Updated player/enemy/cursor grid colors[/p][/*][*][p]Cathedral interior is now fully built and explorable[/p][/*][*][p]Ruiners Pass polish, cutscenes, story elements[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the prologue story, cutscenes, UI[/p][/*][*][p]Created see-through window shader effect for obstructions[/p][/*][/list][p]What's coming up this month? [/p][list][*][p]Add voiced lines to expanded demo[/p][/*][*][p]Finalize expanded demo cutscenes, exploration, and combat[/p][/*][*][p]Testing the expanded demo and bug fixing[/p][/*][/list][h1]Art Corner[/h1][p]As always, our artists are creating tons of new assets, portraits, and characters that help make the world of Ianua immersive and full of life! Take a look at some of the new screenshots: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/cf23eecb65fc72c1b4e2892caa80fb8696cba090.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/2b0ced8c79bc4dbd4af208227940588a32430302.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/628c40e6ea8c62c19d8ecac880550553b86c6250.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/45dffbfc666746c0d242b2619df9caab4acfc5ba.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/00dd32d946ff0efae7a7cb520da77b936cc49bfd.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/ccd1e91753785717c315bbb8503591b7c1661398.png"][/img][/p][h1]Social Space[/h1][p]We got some great feedback from our Discord group on the Ruiners Pass area and are going to share the expanded demo with the Discord community first so make sure you join now to get all the new updates first! [url="https://discord.gg/9CTeRq2Dzn" style="button"]Join the Discord![/url][/p][p]NextUp Games published a Q&A from our team since we were voted one of the top games spotlighted in July - [url="https://nextupgames.com/articles/9f042c81-dcbd-468a-a6e6-a07f89398afd/" style="button" buttoncolor="#da37fb"]Read the Q&A here![/url][/p][p]We're also gearing up for a big campaign with several YouTube creators to spotlight our new demo when it comes out, so stay tuned to our social media since we'll be sharing those videos and streams regularly ːsteamhappyː[/p][h1]What's Coming[/h1][p]Once the expanded demo comes out, we anticipate spending some extra time addressing any new bugs or feedback you all provide! We'll keep focusing on adapting to your suggestions while trying to make Aegis Force as fun to play as possible. [/p][p]As always, thank you for engaging with us, playing our demos, and sharing your ideas! Until next month, FOR GENUA![/p]

notes.title: July 2025 Developer Update
notes.content: [p]Greetings soldiers of Genua! June was an amazing month for Aegis Force as the team made incredible progress on Chapter 1 & the upcoming expanded demo, and we attended our first in-person game conference in Edmonton, Canada![/p][h1]Technical Updates[/h1][p]If you're not already on our Discord or newsletter, [url="https://discord.gg/9CTeRq2Dzn" style="button"]join today[/url] to get access to our Game Con conference build! We've made it available to our growing community so we can get firsthand player feedback on the new area and combat system before releasing the expanded demo next month. We also: [/p][list][*][p]Added Ruiners Pass cutscenes and story events[/p][/*][*][p]Set up cathedral interior integrations[/p][/*][*][p]Made items functional in combat (potions!)[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented new animations and character poses[/p][/*][*][p]Added Enter interactions for houses in Ruiners Pass[/p][/*][*][p]Added new exploration music[/p][/*][*][p]Added destructible objects with loot[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted combat camera views to hide obstructing foliage[/p][/*][/list][p]Check out our gameplay video on Youtube to see what Ruiners Pass is like![/p][previewyoutube="WVE78xnTENU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]What's coming up this month? [/p][list][*][p]Polishing Chapter 1 gameplay, narrative, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Continue developing the city and new interior areas to explore[/p][/*][*][p]Adding more cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Investigating translation options for the demo[/p][/*][/list][h1]Art Corner[/h1][p]Our artists have spent a lot of time creating new assets, characters, and animations that make the world of Ianua feel so much more alive! Here's a few new screenshots and character portraits you might come across soon... [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/2c9a42afadb91aa2160f56f4852237be4e7b9724.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/82c67019de98c141b0bb93d4b9fdf717f89008db.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/7117ca27c7923a82394d68e7059ed851ef172135.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/a01b0adcc8eb3ef4e9cb4bb187a21d463d40e7d1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/ff698854c9f9a836def1a72c687ebbcc1276ed76.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/71dd0fd3e49e15083c48794c80fee7f90f3aa663.png"][/img][/p][h1]Social Space[/h1][p]Our first in-person game conference was a massive success! Three of our team members (plus a few family members along for the ride) had the incredible opportunity to showcase [i]Aegis Force[/i] in the Innovation Zone at GCC. Connecting with fellow fans of pixel art turn-based RPGs was an absolute highlight. The excitement from everyone who visited our booth was inspiring, and we’re already incorporating your feedback and creative ideas into the next phase of development![/p][p]Oh and we ate a lot of amazing Canadian food :) [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/57a1ac46e546c31f7d5e0ff6b5965a5c446785d9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/390c77c603f363768678b0ff1ef34e5237bb7f1b.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]What's Coming[/h1][p]Get ready for a brand new demo and game trailer for [i]Aegis Force: The Scorian War[/i], arriving between July and August. Your feedback from the February 2025 demo and all the feedback from our beta testers and conference attendees helped shape this next phase, and we think you’re going to love what’s in store. From new teammates and fierce new enemies to an all-new playable zone steeped in mysterious lore—it’s time to dive even deeper into the world of Ianua.[/p][p]Also, if you're not following us on all your social media platforms yet, you can find all our links here - [url="https://linktr.ee/deseretgames"]Linktr.ee/deseretgames[/url][/p][p]Until next time, FOR GENUA![/p]

notes.title: June 2025 Developer Update
notes.content:
Greetings soldiers of Genua! June is shaping up to be a crazy month as our developers put the finishing touches on our expanded demo and a few of us pack our bags to head out to Edmonton for Game Con Canada next week! 
[h1]Technical Updates[/h1]
Last month we talked about the new combat system you'll get to experience in the expanded demo and final release and since then, we've made a TON of progress:
[list]
[*] New combat grid visuals
[*] Updated user interface (UI) and heads-up display (HUD)
[*] Upgraded battle animations for all characters
[*] Polishing art and exploration build for new playable area - Ruiners Pass
[/list]
What's coming up this month? 
[list]
[*] Resolving new bugs - current issue with keyboard and mouse controls
[*] Creating new character art, animations, and story for future chapters
[*] Updating music and battle integrations for new playable area
[/list]
Can't wait to share the new gameplay with all of you soon, we'll keep incorporating your feedback and finding new ways to bring the magical world of Ianua to life :) 
[h1]Art Corner[/h1]
Take a look at some of our gorgeous new screenshots of Ruiners Pass! You'll explore this area in Chapter 1 right after the Prologue in Lendene. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/be7e9dbce86280e5c7afc415714e112644f3c2c9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/13d2f0d265677660d3a6277c481dfcf97ea0158f.png[/img]
[h1]Social Space[/h1]
If you're heading to Game Con Canada from 6/13-6/15, [url=https://gcc2025.expofp.com/?deseret-games-studio%2C-llc]come stop by Booth A05[/url] and say hi! We are so excited to talk to everyone about Aegis Force and share an early preview of Ruiners Pass for attendees who play the demo during the conference. Once Game Con is done, we'll also share the new exploration build with our Discord community before the expanded demo is released in July. Make sure you [url=https://discord.gg/9CTeRq2Dzn]join the Discord today[/url] so you get the first look! 

With everything else going on with development and preparing for Game Con Canada, we didn't do a stream or developer Youtube video this month, but we'll share some Youtube content later this month and get back on our regular schedule in July! 
[h1]What's Coming[/h1]
Now that we've made a ton of improvements to the foundational game mechanics (combat, character screens, UI, etc.), we can keep developing new chapters and explorable areas for the final game. Follow us on social media and [url=https://discord.gg/9CTeRq2Dzn]Discord[/url] to keep in touch with us and be the first ones to know when new content is available!
Thank you all again for playing, sharing your thoughts, and engaging with us!

Until next month, FOR GENUA!

notes.title: May 2025 Developer Update
notes.content:
Greetings soldiers of Genua! This summer is going to be VERY busy for our small team as we prepare to release our expanded demo and also participate in multiple events and conferences. 
[h1]Technical Updates[/h1]
The team is laying some serious ground work for a new and improved combat system and the party management user interface. You won't see these changes in the current demo, but we'll have them ready with the expanded demo in a couple months. 

This month we: 
[list]
[*] Added battle action log and health bars above characters
[*] Added new grid-based movement options during combat
[*] Added lootable chests as part of upcoming exploration mechanics
[*] Added UI screens for inventory, characters, equipment, and save system
[/list]
And I know a lot of you will be excited to experience the new critical hits and misses indicators during combat. The enemy sprites stay oriented in the way they ended their turn so you can plan your backstabs accordingly :)

We're still working on: 
[list]
[*] Optimizing keyboard/mouse setup 
[*] Offering accessibility options and controller instructions before the game starts
[*] Adding option to skip dialogue or cutscenes
[*] Affinity system between party members in combat
[/list]
Your feedback and suggestions have been invaluable in helping us understand what's working and what might need a little extra fine-tuning before our release, so please keep it coming! We're listening and actively adjusting as development continues. 

[h1]Art Corner[/h1]
Wekufes and Berzerkers and Bladed Slimes, OH MY! We've got some amazing designs and sprites created for future enemies and characters you'll interact with in the full game. Check out this month's screenshots, updated portrait art, and sprite GIFs! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/fba65c7cd3dd58db13bd6023452e9c062f03eb85.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/40146793c4f9827e888b3b94f094ef2ab6b8615d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/24c6c7e59feaf45e5bf2dc3921e7783896cf0d23.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/2483716ec2d802f5bc66631f46f78a4d201ee79c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312118/03cfc92f2dd3ebeb5f92ea43e8763e6a98e16729.gif[/img]

[h1]Social Space[/h1]
We're participating in multiple indie game events and game conferences this year and hope to meet a lot of current and future Aegis Force fans! The Steam event "Indie Assemble" starts in a couple days so make sure to check it out and show some love to fellow indie game studios. We'll share more information on 5/5!
In June, we're attending Game Con Canada in Edmonton - our first in-person event! While our full expanded demo won't be released yet, we're planning on sharing exclusive playable content for conference attendees to get some pre-release feedback and keep the momentum going. 

Remember to join our [url=https://discord.gg/9CTeRq2Dzn]Discord[/url] and subscribe to @DeseretGamesStudio on Youtube so you can watch our developer diaries, get Aegis Force updates first, and participate in future community events. Our latest developer diary "[url=https://youtu.be/3gcI3-K_kGs?si=46dJJ2YSEAdWuJB2]Pixel Art in a 3D World[/url]"[previewyoutube=3gcI3-K_kGs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] offers some insights into how the art style of Aegis Force: The Scorian War has developed over the last year and where it's still going!

[h1]What's Coming[/h1]
We'll have many more updates to share over the next few months as we keep revamping combat and growing the explorable world of Ianua. Follow us on social media and [url=https://discord.gg/9CTeRq2Dzn]Discord[/url] to keep in touch with us and be the first ones to know when new content is available! 
Thank you all again for playing, sharing your thoughts, and engaging with us!

Until next month, FOR GENUA!

notes.title: April 2025 Developer Update
notes.content:
Greetings soldiers of Genua! It's been another busy month for our developers and artists as they create new characters, playable areas, and new combat mechanics that we plan to share in our future expanded demo this summer. 
[h1]Technical Updates[/h1]
One of the challenges with game development is when you fix one bug and another pops up in its place. It can feel a bit like a game of Whack-a-Mole, but we're glad our demo players are alerting us quickly when new issues arise. 

This month we: 
[list]
[*]Improved audio volume in the opening text crawl
[*]Fixed Shift key bug preventing players from sprinting
[*]Fixed dialogue issues where // kept showing up in the text
[*]Added ability for players to save at any point in the demo
[/list]
Outstanding issues we're working on: 
[list]
[*] Optimizing keyboard/mouse setup
[*] Improving combat camera mechanics
[*] Adding option to skip dialogue or cutscenes
[*] Backstab and sidestab mechanics and better visibility when you land one! 
[/list]
These are just a few of the items our team is focused on resolving, so rest assured we're hearing your input and working towards creating a GREAT player experience. 
[h1]Art Corner[/h1]
One of the characteristics of Aegis Force: The Scorian War that we're super excited to share with our players is the wide variety of playable areas, enemies, flora and fauna, and character races. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3154550/images/]Check out our screenshots[/url] from the last month to see the formidable boss "The Abbot", the Wekufe warrior, and the Moonlit Mare Tavern in Vigherad...
[h1]Social Space[/h1]
Our community keeps growing and we are THRILLED. [url=https://discord.gg/9CTeRq2Dzn]Join our Discord[/url] to get early access to new artwork and updates as well as participate in community RPG streams. 
We released another [url=https://youtu.be/ydCwnJplrEg?si=Ix1oY_1biW5n8uQR]developer diary[/url] on Youtube last month and anticipate releasing these videos every month. Subscribe to @DeseretGamesStudio so you can watch them when they're new! 
[h1]What's Coming[/h1]
Follow us on social media and especially our [url=https://discord.gg/9CTeRq2Dzn]Discord[/url] to see our latest updates! We're still working hard on expanding the demo and plan to release it this summer (around July 2025). We might even be attending a few game conferences later this year... if so, we'll notify you all on our social media first!
Community feedback is 100% welcome and we take every comment seriously. We want you to love this game as much as we do and appreciate everyone's thoughts so far! 

Until next month, FOR GENUA!

notes.title: March 2025 Developer Update
notes.content:
Greetings soldiers of Genua! We’re excited to bring you the latest updates on Aegis Force: The Scorian War and give a sneak peek of some of the amazing creative work going on behind-the-scenes. 

[h2]Technical Updates[/h2]
Raise your hand if you were ever personally victimized by the original backstab mechanic in the demo! Just me? Ok. Well, while we’re actively working on a way for players to know when they successfully land a backstab, we’ve also fixed some of the bugs in our demo build on Steam: 
[list]
[*] Removed automatic self-targeting: you can’t attack yourself now!
[*] Made display settings easier to use for controllers
[*] Added “How to Play” screens for keyboard/mouse and controller setups
[*] Resolved some issues with intermittent freezing
[/list]
Here’s some examples of what our developers are actively working on based on your feedback:
[list]
[*] Backstab and sidestab mechanics
[*] Experimenting with better camera angles during combat that don’t make players feel seasick
[*] Ensuring objects and text above characters doesn’t block the view
[*] Adding more interaction with animals, objects in the environment
[*] Tightening up the dialogue in the demo

And of course, they’re making a TON of progress on the rest of the game, which we can’t wait to share more of in future updates and demo builds! 

[h2]Art Corner[/h2]
Our team is very small, but we are so lucky to have some truly gifted and dedicated artists working on this game. Take a look at some of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3154550/images/]screenshots from the last month[/url] as our artists create new environments and locations for our heroes to explore. 

[h2]Social[/h2]
All of us are absolutely loving the multiple videos, shorts, and streams you’ve all been creating since the demo came out about six weeks ago and we would be happy to share your content on our Discord page. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/vagH6a9wZZ]Discord[/url] if you haven’t already! 

We also have started to record [url=https://youtu.be/mOjXCUMVDRE?si=Z7HVq8u9lX_NhW4i]developer diary[/url] videos on Youtube and did a deep dive into the demo last month. Take a look if you want to learn about the game’s creative vision from the founder and narrative director! 
[h2]What’s Coming[/h2]
Watch for updates on all our social media channels! We’re planning to release an expanded demo later this summer that incorporates all the feedback we’ve been receiving so far while also extending the gameplay into parts of Chapter 1. You’ll explore new environments, meet new characters, and get to test out new mechanics that are still under development (like more advanced terrain interactions!).

Let us know if you have any questions, feedback, or ideas for what you’d like to see in the game in the future. We have been so thrilled by all the thoughtful feedback and ideas so far, and will keep doing all we can do to create an amazing experience for you. 

Until next month, FOR GENUA!
